prompt: My sister cooks better than (I / do), so guests love her dinners.
explanation_ru: После than с глаголом используется подлежащее в именительном падеже (I) и вспомогательный глагол do, заменяющий cooks.

prompt: That brown belt is shorter than (expect), so it does not fit me.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом обороте than expected («чем ожидалось») после than ставится причастие прошедшего времени expected.

prompt: Children must not carry (more / five) books home from the library.
explanation_ru: Перед числительным «больше пяти» передаётся конструкцией more than + число.

prompt: Our second guide smiled warmly and helped us more than the first one (do).
explanation_ru: В придаточном после than вспомогательный глагол повторяет время основного глагола helped — Past Simple, поэтому нужен did.

prompt: Taking the morning train does not cost ___ forty pounds.
explanation_ru: Перед числом используется more than; частая ошибка — писать then («тогда») или of вместо than.

prompt: This second song sounds very different ___ the band's first album.
explanation_ru: После прилагательного different в британском английском ставится предлог from (или to), но не like, with или as.

prompt: Early autumn feels much colder in our town than we expected.
answer: Early autumn feels much colder in our town than we expected.
accepted_answers: Early autumn feels much colder in our town than we expected.
explanation_ru: Предложение составлено правильно: после сравнительной степени colder используется союз than и придаточное предложение we expected.

prompt: Late at night, the street outside Priya's flat feels much calmer (during / the day), so she reads on the balcony.

accepted_answers: than it is during the day
than it feels during the day

explanation_ru: После сравнительной степени calmer сравнение с другим временем суток вводится союзом than перед предложной группой during the day.

prompt: Ciaran finished the forest trail in (little / forty) minutes, which surprised everyone at the club.
explanation_ru: Перед отрезком времени («менее сорока минут») используется less than + числительное, так как период времени воспринимается как единый объём.

prompt: Fortunately, heating our flat costs (no / much) it used to before we replaced the windows.
explanation_ru: Выражение «не больше, чем раньше» с глаголом costs строится как no more than + придаточное it used to.

prompt: Does the annual gym pass really cost (same) the monthly one over twelve months?
explanation_ru: Конструкция «столько же, сколько / такой же, как» всегда требует артикля the и союза as: the same as.

prompt: Marek spent the whole weekend testing two free calendar apps for his bike shop. The green app looks very (similar) the timetable he uses on his laptop. However, it opens much (fast) than the blue one when customers book repairs online. Best of all, setting up the team plan took far less time than he (think).
explanation_ru: После similar нужен предлог to; с глаголом opens используется наречие faster; после than в рассказе о прошлом ставится thought или had thought.

prompt: "Which of your two cats causes more trouble in the flat?" "Honestly, the ginger one sleeps far (much) than the grey one, so he barely moves. The grey cat is completely (different) his brother and climbs onto all the high shelves. He reaches the top cupboard much faster than (I / can), so hiding the biscuits never works."
explanation_ru: С глаголом sleeps сравнительная степень от much — more; после different ставится from (или to); перед модальным глаголом can используется именительный падеж I.

prompt: Sofia tried the new ring road to avoid traffic on her way to the office. Unfortunately, the new route was (not / any / quick) than the village road because of roadworks. Her car crawled in a queue for (more / twenty) minutes near the main roundabout. In the end, she reached the office much later than she (plan).
explanation_ru: Усилитель any стоит перед сравнительной степенью в отрицании (not any quicker); перед числом нужен союз than (more than twenty); после than используется had planned или planned.

prompt: Kenji answered the angry client's email much more patiently than ___ in that situation.
explanation_ru: После than подлежащее перед глаголом стоит в форме I (не me), а смысловой глагол answered в прошлом требует would have, а не глагол be (am/was).

prompt: The company's reply was very similar with the standard message they sent us in May.
answer: The company's reply was very similar to the standard message they sent us in May.
accepted_answers: The company's reply was very similar to the standard message they sent us in May.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — калька с русского «похож с» (similar with); правильно использовать предлог to: similar to.

prompt: The updated booking site caused more delays than the old one did. → The old booking site caused …
answer: The old booking site caused fewer delays than the updated one did.
accepted_answers: The old booking site caused fewer delays than the updated one did.
The old booking site caused fewer delays than the updated one.
The old booking site caused fewer delays than the updated site did.
The old booking site caused fewer delays than the updated site.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным delays используется fewer than, а вспомогательный глагол did в конце можно сохранить или опустить.

prompt: Residents complained that the manager's reply sounded (impatient / helpful), and its tone was noticeably sharper than (that) the previous letter.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух качеств одного предмета используется конструкция more … than …, а that of заменяет существительное tone в единственном числе.

prompt: Chidi noticed that although the new office lease looked simpler at first, its rules on repairs were much stricter than (those) the earlier version, and the agency pushed (hard) than expected.
explanation_ru: Для замены существительного во множественном числе (rules) после than ставится those in (или those of), а с глаголом pushed используется наречие harder.

prompt: Following two public meetings, the town council published its revised plan for local cycle lanes. Local riders said the new design looked completely (different) the rough map shown in March. Instead of cutting into busy junctions, the project will remove (few / twelve) parking spaces across the whole town centre. Even sceptical shop owners admitted that the planners had listened far more carefully than anyone (expect).
explanation_ru: После different нужен предлог from (или to); с исчисляемыми parking spaces — fewer than; в придаточном после than ставится had expected или expected.

prompt: Oksana ordered a lightweight rain jacket before her autumn walking holiday in Scotland. When the parcel arrived, the thin coat weighed (little / half) a kilo and folded neatly into her side pocket. She worried that such soft material would tear on rocks, yet it kept out wind and rain far (well) than her heavy old coat. Her walking partner Owen could barely lift his soaked boots, and he climbed far less steadily than (she / can) on the wet hills.
explanation_ru: Перед мерой веса используется less than; сравнительная степень наречия well — better; в прошедшем времени после than согласуется форма she could.

prompt: Despite being nervous about speaking at the residents' meeting, Nadia's description of the speeding van proved far more accurate than ___.
explanation_ru: Сравниваются два описания, а не описание и человек, поэтому существительное description в единственном числе заменяется на that of (не множественное those of и не глагол did).

prompt: Among all the articles our tutor recommended, Hana's summary reached almost the same conclusion like the textbook, although it explained the examples far more clearly.
answer: Among all the articles our tutor recommended, Hana's summary reached almost the same conclusion as the textbook, although it explained the examples far more clearly.
accepted_answers: Among all the articles our tutor recommended, Hana's summary reached almost the same conclusion as the textbook, although it explained the examples far more clearly.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить like после the same; конструкция всегда требует союза as: the same conclusion as.

prompt: Mateo has worked with the new designer for three months, whereas his colleague Piotr has only met her twice. Which sentence accurately compares how well the two men know the designer?
options: Mateo knows the new designer much better than he knows Piotr.
Mateo knows the new designer much better than Piotr does.
Mateo knows the new designer much better than Piotr is.
Piotr knows the new designer almost as well as Mateo does.
explanation_ru: Вспомогательный глагол does заменяет knows и точно передаёт смысл («лучше, чем её знает Пётр»); вариант с is грамматически неверен, а остальные искажают смысл.
